original_zh: 方法学指南 · 依据 MISEV2023
revised_zh: 方法学指南 · 依据 MISEV2023 及原始研究文献 · 最后核验 2026-11-13
evidence_quote: Minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles (MISEV2023): From basic to advanced approaches (title, J Extracell Vesicles 2024;13:e12404)

original_zh: 没有一种方法在所有样本上都“最好”。提取的本质是在纯度、得率、功能完整性、通量与成本之间做取舍
revised_zh: 各方法在回收率（得率）与特异性（纯度）之间位置不同，组合使用可提高特异性
evidence_quote: Position of some EV separation and concentration methods on a recovery (yield) versus specificity grid. Dashed blue arrows indicate combinations of methods resulting in increased specificity.

original_zh: 用途不同，最优解完全不同（组学要纯度、功能要活性、转化要通量）
revised_zh: MISEV2023 不强制任何技术或标志物，强调“适合目的”；提取方法显著影响组学结果；功能/转化更看重活性与可放大性
evidence_quote: There is no technique or platform that is absolutely required or prohibited by MISEV... Chosen techniques and targets should be fit for purpose (MISEV2023); "We demonstrate that the choice of isolation method severely impacts the purity and accordingly the omics profiles" (Van Deun 2014)
note: “完全不同”属修辞，改为有据表述。

original_zh: 高水平工作普遍采用“浓缩 + 纯化”两步组合
revised_zh: 按不同性质依次组合的分离策略越来越常用并可提高特异性；ISEV 2015 调查中 59% 受访者组合使用多种方法；没有方法能得到 100% 纯的 EV
evidence_quote: complementary separation techniques are increasingly applied sequentially ... which allows increased specificity (MISEV2023); "59% of respondents use a combination of methods" (Gardiner 2016); "We found no 100% pure EV preparations" (Dong 2020)
note: “高水平工作普遍”无量化依据，改为调查数据。

original_zh: 用粒径、形貌、标志蛋白三类证据表征，缺一不可
revised_zh: 用多类互补证据表征（颗粒数量与大小、形貌、蛋白标志、纯度指标）；MISEV2023 不强制特定技术
evidence_quote: There is no technique or platform that is absolutely required or prohibited by MISEV. Similarly, MISEV does not mandate use of any particular marker or markers
note: “缺一不可”与 MISEV2023 原文的非强制立场不符。

original_zh: 推荐逻辑基于 MISEV2023 与各方法公认的性能特征
revised_zh: 推荐逻辑基于 MISEV2023 与已发表的方法比较研究，每条规则附引用（见 recommender-rulesv1.0.json）
evidence_quote: 见各规则引用
note: 原推荐器无引用；已逐条补引用并修正。

original_zh: 通用收尾：NTA＋形貌＋≥3 个阳性标志＋阴性标志＋颗粒/蛋白比
revised_zh: 通用收尾：颗粒数量与大小＋形貌＋MISEV2023 第 1、2、3 类蛋白各至少一种＋分别报告颗粒与蛋白绝对量
evidence_quote: At least one protein of categories 1, 2 and 3 should be analysed as EV hallmarks and to assess the presence of NVEPs in an EV preparation.
note: “≥3 个阳性标志”是 MISEV2014 的要求，非 MISEV2023。

original_zh: 按沉降系数逐级离心——低速去细胞与碎片、中速去大囊泡与凋亡小体、100,000×g 沉淀小 EV
revised_zh: 按沉降系数逐级离心；沉降系数与颗粒大小和密度相关
evidence_quote: Enriches for EV subtypes that are separated according to their sedimentation coefficient, proportional to their diameter and density.

"four consequent centrifugation steps: 10 min at 300 g, 10 min at 2000 g, 30 min at 10000 g, followed by exosome pelleting by centrifugation at 100000 g for 70 min. A repeated 100000 g centrifugation of the re-suspended pellet is usually applied" (Livshits 2015); "a maximal force of around 100,000 to 200,000 × g is applied for 45 to 150 min" (MISEV2023)
note: Théry 2006 原文非 OA，参数经 Livshits 2015 全文交叉核对；2,000×g 原方案为 10 min。

original_zh: 转子型号与 k 因子必须报告，换转子要按 k 因子换算时间
revised_zh: 报告转子型号、rpm、时间、温度及加减速，以计算校正 k 因子并换算
evidence_quote: report speed in rpm and rotor type (to allow calculation of adjusted k‐factor), time of centrifugation ..., and temperature. Instrument acceleration and deceleration settings should also be reported.

original_zh: 无需额外试剂、处理体积灵活、是文献可比性最强的“参照方法”
revised_zh: 不需额外试剂；使用最广泛（ISEV 2015 调查 81%），因而文献可比性最好
evidence_quote: Ultracentrifugation remains the most commonly used isolation method (81%)
note: “可比性最强”依据为使用率，改为数据表述。

original_zh: 共沉淀蛋白聚集体与脂蛋白；沉淀-重悬可致 EV 聚集与膜损伤
revised_zh: 高速长时间离心共分离沉降系数相近的非囊泡颗粒，并可能诱导 EV 聚集
evidence_quote: Co‐isolates NVEPs that have the same sedimentation coefficient as EVs, especially after high‐speed and lengthy ultracentrifugation. May induce aggregation of EVs. (MISEV2023); "high-speed centrifugation induces the formation of EV aggregates" (Linares 2015)
note: “膜损伤”未直接查到证据，未保留该词。

original_zh: 回收率波动大（约 5%–40%）
revised_zh: 回收率偏低：一项血浆纳米流式研究估算单次 100,000×g 2 h 回收约 40%，两次超离约 16%；重复超离降低得率
evidence_quote: "the recovery rate of a single UC step at 100,000 × g for 2 h at 4°C was ~40%. Thus the recovery rate of EV preparation by UC (twice UC at 100,000 × g for 2 h at 4°C) would be ~16%." (Tian 2020); "Repeated ultracentrifugation steps can reduce the quality of exosome preparations leading to lower exosome yield." (Lobb 2015)
note: 5% 下限未找到来源，删除；改为单项研究的具体估算并注明情境。

original_zh: 上清先经 0.22 µm 过滤可提高纯度但会截留大 EV，需在方法中声明
revised_zh: 过滤可把大 EV/颗粒留在滤器上，需注意挤压伪影并声明
evidence_quote: filtration may also be performed to retain microbes (‘sterilization’) or large EVs/EPs in the pre‐filter compartment; although care should be taken to avoid extrusion.

original_zh: 黏性样本（血浆）先稀释再超离
revised_zh: 黏性体液中回收率与黏度成反比，应考虑稀释
evidence_quote: MVs recovery inversely correlates with viscosity and as a result, sample dilutions should be consider[ed]

original_zh: 沉淀用少量 PBS 沿管壁轻柔重悬、避免反复吹打
revised_zh: 保留，标注【实验室惯例】
note: 无直接文献测定，作为操作惯例标注。

original_zh: EV 富集于约 1.08–1.19 g/mL 区间
revised_zh: 常引用的 EV 浮力密度约 1.08–1.19 g/mL；碘克沙醇梯度实测例如约 1.094 g/mL 或 1.10–1.15 g/mL
evidence_quote: "density (1.08–1.19 g/ml)" (Brennan 2020); "buoyant density of ~1.094 g/mL" (Van Deun 2014, OptiPrep); "density of EV‐containing fractions as 1.10–1.15 g/ml" (Dong 2020)
note: 1.08–1.19 主要来自蔗糖梯度时代的外泌体文献；碘克沙醇中常偏低，已注明。

original_zh: 与可溶性蛋白和多数脂蛋白分开
revised_zh: 能与可溶性蛋白及低密度脂蛋白（VLDL/LDL/乳糜微粒）分开，但 HDL 密度（1.063–1.21 g/mL）与 EV 重叠，单靠密度梯度无法去除
evidence_quote: "HDL (d=1.063–1.21 g/mL)" overlaps EV density (Yuana 2014); lipoproteins "overlap in size (all but HDL), density (HDL)" (MISEV2023)
note: 原文“多数脂蛋白”忽略了 HDL 的密度重叠，属关键纠正。

revised_zh: 例如碘克沙醇梯度 100,000×g、4 °C、18 h（Van Deun 2014）；时间依梯度与转子而定
evidence_quote: which was then centrifuged for 18 hours at 100,000 g and 4°C (SW 32.1 Ti rotor)
note: “16 h”下限未找到直接来源，改为具体文献实例。

original_zh: 分段收集后测折光/密度定位 EV 段
revised_zh: 分段收集后用吸光度标准曲线或折光率确定密度
evidence_quote: "To estimate the density of each fraction, a standard curve was made of the absorbance values at 340 nm" (Van Deun 2014); MISEV2023 mentions "measuring refractive index"

original_zh: 纯度最高的方法之一，适合组学与标志物研究
revised_zh: 纯度高于单纯超离与沉淀法，适合组学
evidence_quote: OptiPrep density gradient centrifugation outperforms ultracentrifugation and ExoQuick and Total Exosome Isolation precipitation in terms of purity

original_zh: 碘克沙醇等渗、对 EV 形貌更友好，优于高渗蔗糖
revised_zh: 碘克沙醇在各密度下可配成等渗溶液，更好地保持囊泡大小
evidence_quote: unlike sucrose, iodixanol is capable of forming iso-osmotic solutions at all densities, thus better preserving the size of the vesicles in the gradient

original_zh: 耗时最长、得率低、难以放大；后续需去除梯度介质
revised_zh: 下游分析前通常须去除介质；梯度加洗涤后回收相对较低
evidence_quote: Before performing most downstream assays, the density medium must be removed... Recovery after density gradient and fraction washing is relatively low.

original_zh: EV 大于孔径、先流出，可溶性蛋白与小颗粒滞后流出
revised_zh: 同原意
evidence_quote: larger particles pass through the matrix quickly, without entering the pores, and can be collected as early fractions, while smaller particles (smaller than the matrix pore size) are retained longer

original_zh: 商品化柱（如 qEV）按上样体积选规格；逐段验 NTA/WB 定峰
revised_zh: 商品柱可能重复性更好；必须逐段表征；报告柱参数、空体积、级分
evidence_quote: Commercial columns are often packed under strictly controlled conditions and may allow more reproducible results... Abundance and purity of EVs and other NVEPs in collected fractions must be established through careful characterisation
note: 去掉具体品牌名，避免商业倾向。

original_zh: 温和、无剪切损伤，EV 结构与功能保存好
revised_zh: 超滤+SEC 较超离保留生物物理性质；一项研究中 SEC-EV 功能读出高于超离 EV
evidence_quote: "in contrast to UC-purified EVs, the biophysical properties of UF-LC-purified EVs are preserved" (Nordin 2015); "SEC-EVs bear higher functionality" (Mol 2017)
note: “无剪切损伤”为绝对化表述，改为对比证据。

original_zh: 能有效去除可溶性蛋白与 HDL
revised_zh: 血小板来源样本中 EV 级分含 <5% HDL、<1% 蛋白；血浆中 SEC 去除大部分可溶性蛋白
evidence_quote: "Fractions 9-12 contained ... less than 5% of HDL and less than 1% of protein" (Böing 2014); "SEC removed most of the overabundant soluble plasma proteins" (Gámez-Valero 2016)

original_zh: 操作快、可重复性好
revised_zh: 商品柱可能重复性更好；具体耗时为【估算】
evidence_quote: Commercial columns ... may allow more reproducible results than home‐made columns.

original_zh: 与 EV 尺寸相近的 LDL/VLDL 与乳糜微粒无法分开
revised_zh: 除 HDL 外的脂蛋白与 EV 大小重叠，血浆 SEC 的 EV 级分含脂蛋白/ApoB⁺ 颗粒；LDL 可模拟 EV
evidence_quote: "Vesicle markers peaked in fractions 7-11; however, the same fractions also contained lipoprotein particles" (Karimi 2018); "SEC-sEVs also contained greater amounts of APOB+ lipoproteins" (Takov 2019)

original_zh: 出峰被稀释、常需再浓缩；柱有上样体积上限
revised_zh: SEC 稀释样本，常需前/后浓缩
evidence_quote: SEC dilutes the sample, increasing volume compared with the input material, so concentration of a sample before or after SEC may thus be needed.

original_zh: 大体积先 TFF/超滤浓缩再上柱（“TFF＋SEC”黄金组合）
revised_zh: 超滤/TFF 浓缩 + SEC 是有文献支持的组合
evidence_quote: "Ultrafiltration combined with size exclusion chromatography efficiently isolates extracellular vesicles" (Benedikter 2017 title); UF-LC higher yield than UC (Nordin 2015)
note: “黄金组合”属营销式用语，删除。

original_zh: 柱子按厂家说明再生与保存、记录使用次数
revised_zh: 报告再生方法与使用次数
evidence_quote: if columns are re‐used, method of column regeneration and number of times the column has been used

original_zh: 死端超滤适合小体积；TFF 流体平行于膜面、大体积不易堵膜，可放大
revised_zh: 同原意
evidence_quote: "fluid flows tangentially across the surface, avoiding filter cake formation ... with dead-end filtration, larger particles usually clog the pores" (Busatto 2018)

original_zh: 常用 100–300 kDa MWCO（TFF 常选 300–500 kDa）
revised_zh: 文献所用截留值差异大：例如 100 kDa 离心超滤、10 kDa 超滤后接 SEC、TFF 500 kDa
evidence_quote: "Amicon® Ultra-15 100,000 kDa device" [sic, 100 kDa] (Lobb 2015); "concentrated on 10 kDa centrifuge filters" (Benedikter 2017); "500 kD ... molecular weight cut-off" (Busatto 2018)
note: “常用 100–300 / 300–500 kDa”无系统性来源，改为实例范围。

original_zh: 控制跨膜压与流速，避免高压剪切；最后 diafiltration 换液
revised_zh: 保留为【实验室惯例】，具体设置以设备说明为准
note: 未找到直接文献测定值。

original_zh: 快、便宜、可处理升级上清；TFF 是目前最可放大的路线
revised_zh: 与超离相比 TFF 得率更高、聚集体更少、批间一致性更好、约 1 h、可放大；MSC 3D 培养中 TFF 得率高 7 倍
evidence_quote: "TFF is a more efficient, scalable, and gentler method ... higher yield, less single macromolecules and aggregates (<15 nm in size), and improved batch-to-batch consistency in half the processing time (1 h)" (Busatto 2018)
note: 修正笔误“升升级”（应为“升级”，即以升计的大体积上清）；“最可放大”改为对比证据。

original_zh: 本身不纯化——蛋白聚集体一并浓缩；膜吸附造成损失
revised_zh: 产物含非囊泡颗粒和蛋白的量取决于方法和截留值；不同滤膜对 EV 吸附不同
evidence_quote: Leads to EV‐containing preparations containing variable amounts of NVEPs and proteins, depending on the exact method and variables such as filter cut‐off ... different levels of EV ‘sticking’ and thus recovery

original_zh: 定位为“浓缩步”：TFF 浓缩 → SEC 或密度梯度纯化；预过滤防堵
revised_zh: 同原意
evidence_quote: 0.65 μm prefiltration before 500 kD TFF (Busatto 2018); sequential complementary techniques (MISEV2023)

original_zh: 选低蛋白吸附膜材；回收时用少量 PBS 润洗膜面
revised_zh: 膜材影响吸附有依据；润洗为【实验室惯例】
evidence_quote: different levels of EV ‘sticking’ and thus recovery (Vergauwen et al.)

original_zh: 聚乙二醇降低溶解度、低速离心沉淀 EV——多数“一步法提取试剂盒”即此原理
revised_zh: 同原意；且此类试剂盒并不真正“分离”EV
evidence_quote: Polymer‐based methods of precipitation reduce the availability of biomolecules to solvent, ‘crowding out’ water molecules... Some commercial kits that are described as ‘exosome isolation’ kits in fact rely on such polymer precipitation

revised_zh: 例如 ExtraPEG：4 °C 过夜（≥12 h），3,214×g 1 h，再加一步小体积超离
evidence_quote: incubated at 4 °C overnight (at least 12 hrs). The next day, samples were centrifuged ... (3,214 g) for 1 hour at 4 °C
note: “1,500–10,000×g”范围未找到来源，改为具体实例。

original_zh: 不需要超离机、操作最简、得率高
revised_zh: 不依赖超离机、简便、低成本；“颗粒数”高但非 EV 特异，纯度低
evidence_quote: "Two to four orders of magnitude higher particle concentrations were observed for EV preparations from platelet-free plasma (PFP) by kits when compared with the EV preparation by UC, yet the purity was much lower" (Tian 2020)
note: “得率高”易误导，改为“颗粒回收高（非 EV 特异）”。

original_zh: 共沉淀大量蛋白、脂蛋白、游离核酸与聚合物残留；干扰质谱、RNA 与功能实验
revised_zh: 沉淀法可能达不到明显分离；血浆中 PEG 未去除可溶性蛋白并影响标志物检测；纯度与组学结果不如密度梯度
evidence_quote: "Precipitation methods may not achieve any appreciable separation of EPs" (MISEV2023); "SEC removed most of the overabundant soluble plasma proteins, which were not removed using PEG" (Gámez-Valero 2016)
note: “干扰质谱/RNA/功能”的具体机制未逐一核实，改为已证实的影响。

original_zh: 不同批次与品牌差异大
revised_zh: 删除
note: 未找到直接比较批次/品牌差异的已核验文献。

original_zh: 只用于探索性筛查或后续有纯化步骤时；用前再过 SEC
revised_zh: 同原意，标注依据与【实验室惯例】
evidence_quote: 见上

original_zh: 用抗 CD9/CD63/CD81 抗体捕获带该标志的 EV 亚群
revised_zh: 同原意
evidence_quote: propose their differential separation by immuno-isolation using either CD63, CD81, or CD9 (Kowal 2016)

original_zh: 样本先经差速离心或过滤预纯化再上样
revised_zh: 可先按沉降速度分离再免疫分离；报告探针、基质、孵育、洗涤、洗脱并定量下拉/流穿
evidence_quote: "EVs ... were first separated by their sedimentation speed, and then ... by immuno-isolation" (Kowal 2016); "Efficiency and selectivity must be quantified ... by quantifying material recovered in pull‐down versus flow‐through" (MISEV2023)

original_zh: 洗脱条件（低 pH 或竞争洗脱）决定能否回收完整 EV
revised_zh: 抗体难以与 EV 分离，低 pH 洗脱很可能影响 EV 结构，蛋白酶也可能消化表面蛋白
evidence_quote: Antibodies are particularly difficult to separate from EVs. Low pH treatment classically used to separate antibodies and antigens will likely affect the structure of EVs, and protease treatments may also digest proteins on the surface of the EVs.

original_zh: 特异性最高
revised_zh: 对目标标志阳性颗粒富集强；但会共分离暴露同一决定簇的非囊泡颗粒；EpCAM 捕获的外泌体标志富集高于 UC 与 DG
evidence_quote: "we found IAC-Exos to be the most effective method to isolate exosomes" (Tauro 2012); "Will co‐isolate all EV subtypes or NVEPs which expose a given charge or molecular determinant" (MISEV2023)
note: “特异性最高”改为“针对目标亚群”，评分 5→4。

original_zh: 只捕获阳性亚群（结果不能代表全部 EV）
revised_zh: 例如尿液 CD9/CD63 捕获遗漏近端肾单位来源 EV
evidence_quote: the use of CD9 or CD63 affinity capture for urinary EVs (uEVs) excludes uEVs from cells of the proximal nephron

original_zh: 功能实验慎用
revised_zh: EV 表面被结合分子修饰
evidence_quote: in functional uses, since the EV surface is modified by an EV‐binding molecule

original_zh: 下游是检测时可直接在珠上检测、免洗脱
revised_zh: 保留为【实验室惯例】
note: 合理但未找到直接核验文献。

original_zh: 微流控用声学、介电泳、纳米过滤或免疫捕获分离；AF4 按扩散系数分级
revised_zh: 微流控整合基于大小、电荷、亲和的分离与检测；AF4 按流体力学尺寸分离
evidence_quote: "Smaller particles, diffusing more rapidly, are more likely to enter the higher‐velocity flow regions ... particles are thus separated by hydrodynamic size" (MISEV2023)
note: 具体物理场列举未逐一核实，改为综述可支持的概括。

original_zh: AF4 可把小 EV 与 exomere/supermere 等分开
revised_zh: AF4 分出 Exo-L 90–120 nm、Exo-S 60–80 nm 与 exomere ~35 nm；supermere 是 exomere 上清 367,000×g 超离获得，并非 AF4
evidence_quote: "identified two exosome subpopulations (large exosome vesicles, Exo-L, 90-120 nm; small exosome vesicles, Exo-S, 60-80 nm) and ... exomeres (~35 nm)" (Zhang 2018); "the exomeres were pelleted and the resulting supernatants were subjected to ultracentrifugation at 367,000g to obtain a pellet we termed supermere" (Zhang 2021)
note: 事实错误：supermere 非 AF4 分离。

original_zh: 样本消耗极小、自动化潜力高、尺寸分辨率出色（AF4）
revised_zh: 流场方法无固定相、回收高、最温和之一；AF4 可精确分开大小差异小的颗粒群
evidence_quote: the absence of a solid phase allows high particle recovery. They are also among the gentlest of separation methods ... AF4 can precisely separate particle populations with small differences in size

original_zh: 通量与制备量小、设备贵、方法学尚未标准化
revised_zh: AF4 非 EV 特异、非制备型；部分微流控装置在非 EV 颗粒多时共分离杂质；标准化程度为作者判断
evidence_quote: "it is not specific to EVs in its standard configuration. AF4 is also not a preparative technique." (MISEV2023); "Exodisc has the best EV yield though it may co-separate contaminants" (Dong 2020)

original_zh: 得率 2/5
revised_zh: 改为回收 3/5（回收高但处理量小）；纯度 4→3（非 EV 特异）
evidence_quote: the absence of a solid phase allows high particle recovery
note: 原评分与 MISEV2023 描述矛盾。

original_zh: 为什么高手都用“两步法”；任何单一步骤都只能按一个物理量分离；杂质很少在两个维度上同时重叠
revised_zh: 为什么常用“两步法”；按不同性质依次组合可提高特异性
evidence_quote: complementary separation techniques are increasingly applied sequentially ... which allows increased specificity
note: 去掉“高手”等口语；“很少在两个维度上同时重叠”为推论，未保留。

original_zh: 密度梯度去脂蛋白
revised_zh: 密度梯度去除与 EV 大小重叠但密度不同的脂蛋白（VLDL/LDL/乳糜微粒）；SEC 去 HDL；两者组合
evidence_quote: "The purity of EVs was improved by combining a density cushion with SEC ... reduced the contamination of lipoprotein particles by 100-fold" (Karimi 2018)

original_zh: 功能实验：TFF＋SEC 是当前兼顾得率、纯度与活性的主流组合
revised_zh: 超滤/TFF + SEC 是有文献支持、兼顾得率与生物物理性质的组合
evidence_quote: 见 Nordin 2015 / Benedikter 2017
note: “主流”无量化依据。

original_zh: 组学与标志物：dUC＋密度梯度 或 SEC＋超滤浓缩
revised_zh: dUC + 密度梯度；血液样本 SEC 与密度分离联用
evidence_quote: 见上

original_zh: 评分为领域内相对共识
revised_zh: 评分为基于所引比较研究和 MISEV2023 的定性共识，非测量值；每行附主要依据
note: 原表无引用。

original_zh: 耗时：dUC 4–6 h；DGUC 18–24 h；SEC 0.5–1 h；TFF 1–3 h；沉淀 过夜+0.5 h；免疫 3–5 h；AF4 1–2 h
revised_zh: 改为【估算】：dUC 约 4–5 h（离心合计约 3 h 10 min）；DGUC 约 1 天（18 h 梯度离心）；SEC 柱上通常 <1 h 另加浓缩；TFF 约 1 h（200 mL 级）；沉淀 ≥12 h + 约 1 h；免疫与 AF4 依方案/平台
evidence_quote: TFF "half the processing time (1 h)" (Busatto 2018); PEG "overnight (at least 12 hrs) ... 1 hour" (Rider 2016)
note: 原表数值多无来源；免疫 3–5 h、AF4 1–2 h 删除具体数字。

original_zh: 聚合物沉淀 得率 最高
revised_zh: 颗粒数最高（非 EV 特异）
evidence_quote: "Two to four orders of magnitude higher particle concentrations ... yet the purity was much lower"

original_zh: 免疫亲和 纯度 最高（亚群）
revised_zh: 目标亚群特异性高（会共分离暴露同一决定簇的颗粒）
evidence_quote: 见 C 免疫亲和

original_zh: 用去 EV 血清（100,000×g ≥18 h 预处理 FBS）
revised_zh: 18 h 超离（Shelke：120,000×g）去除约 95% 含 RNA 的 FBS EV，1.5 h 不够；也有用 100,000×g 18 h；但自制或商品“去 EV 血清”均会残留 EV，需验证；去除效果可能取决于稀释
evidence_quote: "an 18-hour centrifugation period eliminates approximately 95% of RNA-containing FBS EVs, whereas a 1.5-hour protocol is insufficient" (Shelke 2014); "Exo-FBS™ CM provided the largest depletion (75%) of total FBS EVs, while still providing 6.92 × 10⁸ ... EVs/mL" (Lehrich 2018); "Commercial ‘EV‐free’ products should also not be assumed to be devoid of EVs without verification" (MISEV2023)
note: 原句隐含“处理后即无 EV”，已纠正。

original_zh: 明确的无血清窗口培养 24–48 h
revised_zh: 无血清/限定培养基可用，但可能改变细胞生理与 EV 产生；24–48 h 为【实验室惯例】
evidence_quote: Use of both EV‐depleted medium and ‘defined’ (serum/PL‐free) media may alter cell physiology and EV production

original_zh: 记录细胞密度、活率（应 >90%）、传代数。死细胞多 → 凋亡小体污染
revised_zh: 报告身份、接种与收获密度、收获时活率、传代数；少数死亡细胞的 EV 可超过健康细胞 EV；>90% 阈值为【实验室惯例】
evidence_quote: EVs produced by only a few percent of dying cells may outnumber EVs generated by healthy cells, the proportion of live and dying cells in a culture affects proportions of EV subtypes and EV quantity
note: “>90%”无指南依据。

revised_zh: 同原意（4 °C 为惯例）
evidence_quote: 见 dUC 参数

original_zh: 当天处理不了先 −80 °C 冻存上清并记录冻融次数（只冻融一次）
revised_zh: 先去除细胞再冻存；报告储存温度、时长和冻融次数
evidence_quote: Remove cells from all EV source materials as early as possible ... Report all storage parameters pre‐ and post‐EV separation (including ... number of freeze‐thaw cycles and thawing method)

original_zh: <30 mL 用超滤管或直接 dUC；≥100 mL 用 TFF
revised_zh: 体积分界标为【实验室惯例】；TFF 适合大体积有文献支持
evidence_quote: TFF for "large volumes of fluid" (Busatto 2018 title)

original_zh: NTA 定量粒径与浓度、蛋白定量算颗粒/蛋白比、WB 验标志；−80 °C 保存，避免反复冻融
revised_zh: 分别报告颗粒和蛋白绝对量；储存参数全部报告；储存缓冲液见质控
evidence_quote: it is recommended to provide absolute protein and particle concentrations separately if ratios are reported

original_zh: 肌肉来源 EV（原代卫星细胞 / 成肌细胞上清）；Pax7⁺ 比例；“再生信号”；增殖/迁移/分化读出
revised_zh: 泛化为“原代细胞上清的提取优化（通用示例）”，删除肌肉、Pax7、再生等具体研究方向
note: 按所有者要求去除私人研究方向。

original_zh: 供体年龄、细胞纯度与分化状态对 EV 产量和 cargo 影响大于提取方法本身
revised_zh: 供体、细胞纯度、分化/激活状态应作为产 EV 细胞特征报告；“大于提取方法本身”无比较证据，删除
evidence_quote: characteristics of producing cells including identity, seeding and harvest density and viability at harvest
note: 比较性断言无证据。

original_zh: 汇合度约 70%–80% 时换液，收集 24–48 h
revised_zh: 标为【实验室惯例】

original_zh: 务必设“无细胞培养基同流程空白”对照
revised_zh: 同原意
evidence_quote: Non‐conditioned medium controls should be processed and characterised to assess the contribution of the medium itself to putative EV measurements.

original_zh: 剂量同时报告颗粒数与蛋白量
revised_zh: 以蛋白替代 EV 浓度需谨慎；同时报告两者
evidence_quote: Protein concentration as a surrogate of EV concentration should be used with caution and is generally not recommended

original_zh: 脂蛋白、可溶性蛋白、血小板来源 EV
revised_zh: 血小板、脂蛋白、溶血产物、可溶/聚集蛋白
evidence_quote: Major contaminants/co‐isolates of blood EVs are platelets, lipoproteins, haemolysis products, and a host of soluble/aggregated proteins

original_zh: 空腹采血、抗凝剂统一
revised_zh: 空腹采血降低乳糜微粒；选择与下游兼容的采血管/抗凝剂；粗针头减少血小板活化与溶血
evidence_quote: collect blood from overnight‐fasted donors ... use the largest feasible needle gauge to minimise platelet activation and haemolysis

original_zh: 2,500×g 两次离心制备乏血小板血浆；采血后 2 h 内处理
revised_zh: ISTH 方案：采血后 <2 h、室温 2,500×g 15 min 离心两次、不用刹车，得无血小板血浆（PFP）；量化残余血小板
evidence_quote: "the delay before the first centrifugation was < 2 h. (v) Samples were centrifuged at 2500 ×g for 15 min at room temperature avoiding application of the centrifuge brake ... The plasma was then centrifuged a second time at 2500 ×g for 15 min" (Lacroix 2013)
note: 补充时长、温度（室温，非 4 °C）、刹车条件；原方案称 PFP。

original_zh: 溶血样本弃用并记录
revised_zh: 评估并报告溶血（MIBlood-EV）；是否弃用由研究方案预先规定
evidence_quote: three common confounders (i.e., haemolysis, platelets and lipoproteins)

original_zh: 凝血过程释放的血小板 EV；优先改用血浆；结论与血浆数据不可直接混用
revised_zh: 凝血中血小板释放的 EV 可占血清 EV 50% 以上；血浆是 EV 的生理介质
evidence_quote: platelet-derived EV released after blood collection during the process of clot formation may account for over 50% of EV in serum. Thus, although serum certainly has appropriate uses, plasma is the physiological medium of EV in the blood.

original_zh: THP 聚合物网罗 EV
revised_zh: 同原意，并会共分离降低纯度
evidence_quote: THP can not only co‐isolate with uEVs, reducing uEV purity, but also polymerise into lattice‐like networks that trap uEVs, reducing uEV yield.

original_zh: DTT 等处理释放被 THP 网罗的 EV（需在方法中声明）
revised_zh: DTT 可解聚 THP；也有报告改善有限
evidence_quote: "addition of dithiothreitol to the low-speed pellet disrupted the polymeric network" (Fernández-Llama 2010); "Some groups have reported that DTT only slightly improves the yield" (Erdbrügger 2021)

original_zh: 按肌酐或体积归一化
revised_zh: 归一化尚无共识；可用计时尿排泄率，或以渗透压/肌酐近似
evidence_quote: "there is no consensus method or marker(s) accounting for excretion rate" (MISEV2023); "may be approximated by normalization to urine osmolality or creatinine in a spot urine" (Erdbrügger 2021)

original_zh: 合并样本、低吸附耗材、唾液去黏液层
revised_zh: 标为【实验室惯例】
note: MISEV2023 未查到对应直接建议。

original_zh: 直接消化组织会产生膜碎片伪影；Matrigel 空白对照
revised_zh: 组织 EV 制备中细胞与细胞伪影是主要污染，应追踪应被耗竭的细胞组分；Matrigel 对照为【实验室惯例】
evidence_quote: cells and cellular artefacts may be the key contaminants of tissue EV preparations

original_zh: 质控清单（MISEV2023 最低要求）；四类证据齐全
revised_zh: 质控清单（依据 MISEV2023）；MISEV2023 不强制特定技术/标志物，要求互补证据
evidence_quote: MISEV does not mandate use of any particular marker or markers

original_zh: NTA（或 TRPS、纳米流式）报告粒径与浓度，注明仪器设置与稀释倍数
revised_zh: 同原意，并报告检测下限
evidence_quote: Report instrument settings, software platforms and versions ... LOD

original_zh: 负染 TEM 的“杯状”是干燥伪影
revised_zh: 干燥条件下形成杯状伪影，水合条件下不出现
evidence_quote: desiccated conditions may cause EVs to form an artefactual cup shape, not seen under hydrated conditions

original_zh: 至少 3 个 EV 相关蛋白，含跨膜蛋白与胞质蛋白
revised_zh: MISEV2023：第 1 类（跨膜/GPI）、第 2 类（胞质）、第 3 类（非 EV 共分离物，纯度对照）各至少一种；“≥3 个阳性”源自 MISEV2014
evidence_quote: "At least one protein of categories 1, 2 and 3 should be analysed" (MISEV2023); MISEV2018 lists MISEV2014 item "At least three positive protein markers of EVs ... Still valid but has evolved"
note: 原稿把 MISEV2014 要求误标为 MISEV2023。

original_zh: calnexin、GM130 应缺失；体液加测 ApoB、ApoA1 与白蛋白
revised_zh: ApoA1/ApoB/白蛋白属第 3 类（必测纯度对照）；calnexin/GM130 属第 4 类，MISEV2023 为可选，可能存在于某些亚型；宜报告耗竭程度而非有/无
evidence_quote: "Analysis of proteins of category 4 is optional, as they may be present in some subtypes of EVs" (MISEV2023); "it may be more appropriate to assay and report depletion than to expect a binary presence/absence of proposed negative markers" (MISEV2018)
note: 原稿把可选的第 4 类当作必需阴性标志，且用“应缺失”的二元表述。

original_zh: 颗粒/蛋白比是常用纯度代理指标，比值越高通常纯度越好
revised_zh: 补充 Webber & Clayton 阈值及 MISEV2023 分开报告要求
evidence_quote: "ratios >3×1010 P/µg equate to high vesicular purity, ratios of 2×109 to 2×1010 P/µg represent low purity, and any ratios below 1.5×109 P/µg are unpure" (Webber 2013); "it is recommended to provide absolute protein and particle concentrations separately if ratios are reported" (MISEV2023)

original_zh: 有条件时报告回收率与每步损失
revised_zh: 报告投入量与各步参数；亲和方法定量下拉/流穿
evidence_quote: Efficiency and selectivity must be quantified ... pull‐down versus flow‐through

original_zh: 离心写转子、k 因子、实际 g 值与温度；SEC 写柱型号与收集段；TFF 写膜 MWCO、面积与跨膜压
revised_zh: 离心：转子、rpm、时间、温度、加减速；SEC：填料、柱尺寸、空体积、级分；过滤：膜与截留值（面积/跨膜压为【实验室惯例】）
evidence_quote: 见 MISEV2023 Reporting recommendations

original_zh: −80 °C、PBS 分装、冻融 ≤1 次
revised_zh: 冻融影响证据不一致，避免反复冻融或评估影响并报告；−80 °C 随时间降低浓度和纯度；单纯 PBS 储存回收率大幅下降，PBS-HAT 更稳定
evidence_quote: "There is conflicting evidence on the effects of freeze‐thaw cycles on EV properties" (MISEV2023); "storing EVs in PBS over time leads to drastically reduced recovery" (Görgens 2022); "-80°C storage reduces EVs concentration and sample purity in a time-dependent manner" (Gelibter 2022)
note: 原稿推荐 PBS 储存与有证据的结论相反。

original_zh: 不要把小 EV 直接叫外泌体；用“小 EV（<200 nm）”
revised_zh: 除非证明内体来源不宜称外泌体；“小 EV”常描述为 <200 nm 但无严格界限，直径依方法而定
evidence_quote: "Unless subcellular origin can be demonstrated, it is likely that a broad population of EVs is being studied, not exosomes specifically." "small EVs are often described as <200 nm in diameter. However, measured diameter is related to the specific characterization method."

original_zh: 及 EV-TRACK 报告规范相关共识
revised_zh: EV-TRACK 知识库用于提高透明度
evidence_quote: we describe EV-TRACK, a crowdsourcing knowledgebase (http://evtrack.org) that centralizes EV biology and methodology

original_zh: NTA 颗粒数虚高：多为蛋白聚集体/脂蛋白被计数
revised_zh: 血浆 EV 大小颗粒多为脂蛋白（以 LDL 为主）；试剂盒颗粒数高纯度低
evidence_quote: the majority of circulating particles within the size range of extracellular vesicles lacked common vesicular markers. We identified most of these particles as lipoproteins (predominantly low-density lipoprotein, LDL)

original_zh: 得率突然变低：查活率、血清批次、膜吸附、k 因子
revised_zh: 同原意并附依据
evidence_quote: 见上

original_zh: 批间波动大：固定窗口、操作者、耗材批次
revised_zh: 标为【实验室惯例】

original_zh: 必须设流程空白与 EV 去除对照（如超离后上清）
revised_zh: 非 EV 级分、EV 去除级分或酶处理级分对照
evidence_quote: controls consisting of non‐EV‐containing, EV‐depleted or enzymatically treated EV separation fractions can help to identify if a function is specific to EVs or associated with co‐isolating materials

original_zh: 冻融杀活性：反复冻融使颗粒聚集、功能下降
revised_zh: 储存条件可改变 EV 浓度、大小与功能相关特性；冻融证据不一致
evidence_quote: 见质控-储存
note: “杀活性”绝对化，改写。

original_zh: 换了提取方法，旧方法剂量—效应关系不能平移
revised_zh: 提取方法显著影响纯度与组学结果，故不能平移；平行比较为【实验室惯例】
evidence_quote: the choice of isolation method severely impacts the purity and accordingly the omics profiles

original_zh: 主要依据：Welsh 2024 MISEV2023 …；Théry 2018 MISEV2018 …
revised_zh: 保留并扩展为 45 条经 API 核验的编号文献
evidence_quote: PubMed/Crossref 元数据一致

original_zh: 用于学位课题时，提取方案与质控标准请与导师确认后写入预注册/开题方案
revised_zh: 删除；改为通用表述：用于正式研究时，方案与质控标准建议写入研究方案/预注册
note: 按所有者要求去除私人信息。
